title: Aerovia scientific evidence
description: Contract science 1.0.0: data/artifacts/science.json, written by data-pipeline/aerovia_pipeline/surrogate_export.py (export) and extended by frontend/scripts/verify-learned-browser.mjs (validation.browserEvidence, validation.browserParity). Methods, regimes, per-case predictions, held-out fixtures, the benchmark (rows, aggregate, calibration, degradation, family hold-out), training receipts, ONNX validation and provenance. Read by the documentation pages and the Benchmark through frontend/src/learned/index.ts.

benchmark.description: The held-out evaluation; the degradation, family hold-out and diagnosticsCreatedAt keys come from the separate diagnostics run (surrogate_diagnostics.py) and are absent before it.

validation.description: ONNX parity per model, the domain controls and the browser parity statement; browserEvidence is added when verify-learned-browser.mjs publishes.

text.description: A reader-facing string, bilingual at the source.

prediction.description: One learned prediction for a case and regime: raw flows, the physical result recomputed from them (message states that residual acceptance failed for a learned approximation) and its errors against the reference.
